newsitem.title: USA: BankBoston raises merger savings goal.
newsitem.headline: BankBoston raises merger savings goal.

text.p: BankBoston Corp said Thursday it raised its estimate of the cost savings it expects to achieve in connection with the July acquisition of BayBanks Inc to $230 million from the previously announced $190 million.
BankBoston said major systems and branch conversions are expected to be completed by the middle of next year with full realization of these savings to occur by the latter half of 1997.
A charge for merger-related costs was also increased to $180 million ($117 million after-tax), $40 million above the figure announced in December.
Earlier Thursday, BankBoston said operating earnings for the third quarter of 1996, which exclude the merger charge, rose 13 percent to $197 million.
